about: Section 9 go-validation sample (audit report v2): 30 statements never used elsewhere in the repository. Band A matches an existing use case, band B is a use case plus 1-2 new capabilities, band C has a core that depends on integrations the library does not cover. `requirements` are what a reviewer expects (canonical, written before any run); `match` are case-insensitive regular expressions that must all match one compiled criterion for the automatic mapping, which a person confirms in review.json. `gaps` are the capabilities that must be warned about before generating (B: the new ones, C: the core); `knownToGate` says whether the platform is named in the scope gate's code list on the day the statements were written (2026-10-16), to separate keyword hits from real detection.

statements.prompt: Online booking for Paws & Suds, a dog grooming salon in Valencia with two groomers. Customers pick a service (bath 40 min, full groom 90 min, nail trim 15 min), a groomer or "any groomer", and a free time, without creating an account. They get a confirmation email with a link to cancel up to 12 hours before. Groomers see their calendar by day and by week, can block days off, and can move or cancel appointments; the customer gets an email when that happens. Never allow two appointments for the same groomer at the same time.

requirements.text: Customers book a service with a chosen groomer or any groomer
Only real free times are offered; no double booking for the same groomer
Confirmation email with a cancel link
Cancellation allowed only up to 12 hours before
Staff calendar per groomer by day and week
Staff move or cancel; the customer is emailed

statements.prompt: Booking website for Ink Harbor tattoo studio: clients choose a consultation (30 min) or a session (2 h), pick an artist and a free slot, and get an email confirmation. Artists see their week and can take days off.

requirements.text: Clients book a consultation or a session with an artist
Only free slots are offered (no double booking)

statements.prompt: Online shop for Hoja Verde, a loose-leaf tea brand. Each tea comes in 50 g, 100 g and 250 g, each size with its own price, SKU and stock. Prices in EUR and GBP (fixed per currency, no conversion). Shipping to Spain and the United Kingdom with a flat rate per country. A WELCOME10 code gives 10% off the first order above 25 EUR. Card payment with Stripe Checkout, stock goes down when an order is paid, and an admin panel to manage teas, sizes, codes and orders.

requirements.text: Product catalogue with images and prices
Variants by size with own price, SKU and stock
Fixed prices in EUR and GBP
Percent discount code with minimum order
Stock decreases when an order is paid
Admin manages products, codes and orders

statements.prompt: Small online shop for my hand-poured soy candles: about 20 products with photos, a cart, card payment and an admin page where I see orders and update stock.

Client portal for Lingua Bridge, a translation agency. Clients sign in and submit a translation request with a title, language pair, deadline and description, attaching the documents to translate (PDF or DOCX, up to 20 MB each). They follow the status of each request (received, in progress, delivered). Project managers see all requests, change the status and leave a comment for the client. A client never sees another client's requests.

requirements.text: Submit a request with title, language pair, deadline and description
Attach PDF/DOCX documents up to 20 MB
Clients follow the status of each request
Clients only see their own requests

statements.prompt: Planning board for Olive & Vow, a wedding planning agency. Each wedding is a project with a kanban (To do, Booked, Confirmed, Done). Tasks are assigned to a planner, with a due date and a priority, and planners discuss them in comments. Every planner has a "My tasks" page with what is due first.

requirements.text: Kanban board with columns; move tasks between them
My tasks page ordered by due date

statements.prompt: A tracker for my hydration and sleep: I log glasses of water and hours slept each day, set a daily goal for each, see my streak and the last 30 days, plus weekly totals.

requirements.text: Quick logging of water and sleep per day

statements.prompt: Internal tool for Rueda Libre, a bike rental shop, to manage the fleet: each bike has frame number, model, size, status (available, rented, in repair) and last service date. Staff sign in, search and filter the table, import the current fleet from a CSV file and export the list to CSV.

requirements.text: Bikes table with frame number, model, size, status and last service date

statements.prompt: Dashboard for our customer support team. Every week we upload a CSV with tickets per day by channel (email, chat, phone) and the average first response time. Show the KPIs compared with the previous period, a line chart over time, a breakdown by channel, a date range filter and an export of the filtered data.

requirements.text: CSV upload of tickets per day and channel
KPIs compared with the previous period

statements.prompt: Website for Cervecera Tramuntana, a craft brewery in Girona: home, our beers, about the brewery, a news blog with an RSS feed, a contact form, and an admin panel to edit the pages and posts and read the messages.

Booking app for Pilates Norte studio: clients book 55-minute private classes with an instructor of their choice in a free slot, get a confirmation email and can cancel up to 24 hours before. Instructors see their calendar and can take days off. On top of that, every client gets an automatic WhatsApp reminder 24 hours before the class and can cancel by replying CANCEL to that WhatsApp message.

requirements.text: Clients book with a chosen instructor

statements.prompt: Online shop for Almazara Sierra, a family olive oil mill: bottles of 500 ml, 1 l and 5 l with their own price and stock, cart, Stripe Checkout, shipping to Spain and Portugal, and an admin panel for orders. Every paid order must produce an electronic invoice compliant with Spain's Verifactu system, submitted automatically to the tax agency (AEAT), and the customer receives the invoice PDF by email.

requirements.text: Catalogue with bottle sizes as variants (own price and stock)
Invoice PDF emailed to the customer

statements.prompt: Appointment booking for a practice with two nutritionists: patients choose first visit (60 min) or follow-up (30 min), a nutritionist and a free time, and get a confirmation email with a cancel link. Each nutritionist's appointments must sync both ways with their Google Calendar (their private events block slots), and online consultations get a Zoom meeting link created automatically.

requirements.text: Patients book a service with a nutritionist
Only free times; no double booking

statements.prompt: Tenant portal for Casa Prado property management. Tenants sign in, report maintenance issues with a description and photos, and follow their status. Staff review the issues and update the status. Lease renewals are signed electronically with DocuSign from the portal, and the signed PDF is stored with the tenant.

statements.prompt: Online store for Surco Records, a second-hand vinyl shop: each record has photos, a price and a condition (mint, very good, good) as variants with their own stock, cart, card payment with Stripe and shipping inside the EU. When an order is paid, the shipping label must be created automatically in Sendcloud and the customer gets the tracking number by SMS.

Task board for our web development agency: projects with a kanban board, tasks with assignee, due date and priority, comments, and a personal task list. Post a message to our Slack channel whenever a task moves to Done or someone is mentioned in a comment.

Website for Es Racó Retreats, a yoga retreat centre in Mallorca: home, retreats, about us, blog, contact form and an admin panel to edit everything. The home page must show our latest Instagram posts, pulled automatically from our Instagram account every hour.

CRM for Brillo, a home cleaning company. Each office is a workspace with admin and staff roles. Manage clients (name, address, phone, cleaning frequency) and visits (date, assigned cleaner, status). The day before each visit, send the client an SMS reminder through Twilio.

Twilio SMS reminder the day before
